name: @equin/plugin-debug-profiling-tab-memory
description: Tab memory: every page samples itself (JS heap, DOM nodes, canvases, images, its open in-app tabs and route) every 5 minutes into its server's tab-memory log, and Debug → Tab memory draws each page beside each Chrome renderer's footprint so a climbing renderer can be tied to a tab, app and route. Plus the measurement scripts: clean-soak (native memory per allocator with nothing attached) and listener-probe (who adds a tab's event listeners).
